reason: The core defect is real but the stated result is wrong. If the credential lookup and the DB fallback both find nothing, `credential` stays undefined (EventManager.ts ~511-541) and is still passed to `updateEvent`; `getCalendar(undefined)` returns null, then `credential.appName` throws (CalendarManager.ts:279,314). This does not become a failure result for every calendar: `return Promise.all(result)` at EventManager.ts:590 has no `await`, so the catch at :591 never runs and the whole `updateAllCalendarEvents` call rejects up to its callers (e.g. :290).
